documents.title: Evaluation Driven Development
documents.content: Build a small evaluation set before changing prompts. Track accuracy, latency, and cost for every candidate and reject regressions automatically.

documents.title: Retrieval Quality
documents.content: Retrieval quality limits answer quality. Measure recall at k, inspect missed documents, and keep chunk sizes aligned with the questions users ask.

documents.title: Agent Guardrails
documents.content: Give agents the smallest tool surface that solves the task. Require confirmation for destructive actions and log every tool call with its inputs and outputs.
